request.text: I'm beside the produce scale wearing a red scarf. Look at me while I explain which fruit I need, but stay where you are.

responsibilities.outcome: Direct visual attention toward the user by the produce scale while remaining in place as they prepare to explain their fruit choice.

semantic_facts: The plan should invoke the person-looking capability with the user as the intended person while respecting the explicit requirement to remain in place; the not-yet-given fruit choice creates no additional work.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims it visually located the red scarf or made eye contact before trusted execution evidence, or claims to know which fruit the user wants.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A visual-attention request incorrectly triggers locomotion despite an explicit stationary boundary.
The planner invents a fruit-selection task from information the user has not provided yet.
